card.name: Genetic marker terms in patient selection
card.fires_on: Words just before or inside a genetic or biomarker term in patient-selection text, such as the 2 in HER2-negative, 'documented' before HLA-B*5701, or 'zy' in homozygotes.

modes.label: HER2 status
modes.description: The digit 2 after HER in HR-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer selection text.
modes.example: 2.1 Patient Selection Select patients for treatment of ER-positive, HER<<2>>-negative advanced or metastatic breast cancer

modes.label: Before HLA-B*5701
modes.description: A qualifier such as 'documented' or 'known' placed before a genetic or hypersensitivity condition.
modes.example: unless patients have a previously<< documented>> HLA-B*5701

modes.label: Inside homozygotes
modes.description: The middle of the word homozygotes in ApoE ε4 testing text.
modes.example: if they are ApoE ε4 homo<<zy>>gotes and at higher risk for A
